role: prospective finite authored comparison; not random holdout or reliability estimate

work.units: modeled MWh-equivalent useful IT work; no measured FLOP conversion

decision_information: All jobs and baseline public day-ahead profiles known at t=0. No fault identity known before t=8. All scenario decisions identical for t<8; one schedule per observed named fault after t=8. No observation errors modeled. Work schedule is common across all scenarios, a conservative causal policy subset.

network.model: lossless DC, base100MVA, source transformer taps, source continuous branch ratings, no existing-load shedding
network.thermal: all nonzero thermal units committed throughout; source PMin/PMax and hourly ramp; fault unit drops only at reveal
network.csp_and_existing_storage: disabled rather than inventing intertemporal energy

equipment.backup_start: instantaneous hourly approximation; no physical UPS qualification

ordinary_route: Same complete information, equipment, construction, solver and cost permissions. If it delivers same accepted outcome at same complete budget, residual is rejected, even if construct works.
firm_reinforcement: Do not invent accepted rights, commissioned capacity, lead times or quotes. Report as unresolved outside options with maximum affordable additional quote relative to constructed route; never label missing quote infeasible. A real complete route could dominate.
objective: Minimize first-year equivalent equipment cost plus worst-case modeled daily operating cost times365, under every registered scenario; annual repetition is a conditional tariff envelope, NOT annual simulation or profit.
cost_evidence: All monetary coefficients are explicit uncalibrated scenario assumptions, NOT vendor quotes, local tariffs or verified complete installed costs. Missing tax, permitting, interconnection, backup-emission permissions, curtailment compensation and jurisdiction-specific residuals remain additive unknown U. Report known modeled subtotal + U, never real complete cost.

finance.cash: capital plus contingent reserve plus working capital needed before service; no receipt or native account created
finance.availability: unknown; conditional coverage only, no secured funds or loan execution

acceptance.independent_checker: different code reconstructs source bounds, nodal balances, flows, ramps, equipment state, deadline and causal constraints from witness; negative mutations must be rejected
acceptance.optimality: HiGHS primal/dual residual and gap in declared continuous policy class only, no global enterprise or equilibrium claim

falsification: Any admissible registered stress breaks work, network or equipment contract
Strong existing complete flexible route supplies same modeled accepted outcome within same full modeled budget
Unknown physical or commercial qualification prevents promotion even with numerical pass
stopping: Run all8 location/day/scale primary models and registered controls once on frozen source; retain infeasible/failed outcomes. Fix implementation bugs openly and rerun as amended-source reproduction, not untouched confirmation. No new scenarios selected after favorable outcomes to claim preregistered success.
authority: Public code and compact evidence only; no outreach, paid APIs, spending, real connection, deployment, transactions or existing native account changes.
